subject: weather
title: Watch the weather
summary: Spot the weather, choose what to take outdoors and notice how the sky can change.

items.label: sunshine
items.fact: Sunshine can make the ground and air warmer.
items.clue: The sun is shining brightly on the playground. What do you see?

items.label: clouds
items.fact: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water or tiny pieces of ice.
items.clue: What are the white or grey shapes floating in the sky?

items.label: rain
items.fact: Rain is water that falls from clouds.
items.clue: Drops of water are falling from the clouds. What is happening?

items.label: wind
items.fact: Wind is moving air. You can notice it when leaves or flags move.
items.clue: You cannot see the moving air, but it is making the leaves flutter. What is it?

items.label: sun hat
items.fact: A wide hat helps shade your head on bright days.
items.clue: What could you wear to shade your face in bright sunshine?

items.label: rain boots
items.fact: Rain boots help keep your feet dry in puddles.
items.clue: What could you wear to keep your feet dry in puddles?

items.label: kite
items.fact: A kite needs moving air to stay up. Fly it in an open, safe space.
items.clue: What can you hold by a string and fly in a gentle breeze?

items.label: puddle
items.fact: A puddle can form where rain collects on the ground.
items.clue: After the rain, some water has collected in a shallow dip. What is it?

items.label: rainbow
items.fact: You may see a rainbow when sunlight shines through raindrops.
items.clue: The sun shines through drops of rain and a coloured arc appears. What is it?
